# SpendWise

> Free AI-powered expense tracker and budget manager built for India.

SpendWise helps people track daily spending, set monthly budgets, and review
AI-assisted financial insights. It is designed around Indian usage patterns:
Rupee (₹) as the primary currency, Lakhs/Crores formatting, and an Indian
financial year (April–March) view.

## Product

- Manual expense and income tracking with Needs/Wants categorization
- Dynamic budget management and 50/30/20 style analysis
- AI-assisted spending analysis and natural-language chat input
- Group expense splitting
- CSV export and tax-season PDF reports
- Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline support
- Free for personal use
